notes.title: Stario: Haven Tower to Reveal Early Access Release Info on September 18
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Since the Steam Next Fest, we’ve been hearing the same question again and again across different platforms: [i]“When will the game finally launch?”[/i] As a small indie team, we’re truly grateful for all the love and attention you’ve shown [i]Stario: Haven Tower[/i]![/p][p]Over the past months we’ve been fully focused on wrapping up development—working day and night on the final stretch of testing and polishing. And now, the moment has finally come to share some exciting news: [i]Stario: Haven Tower[/i] will be featured on [b]September 18 [/b]at the [b]Convergence Showcase[/b], which will also be streamed on IGN. During the Convergence Showcase, we’ll premiere a brand-new Early Access trailer and announce details on the EA release date and pricing. We’ll save the rest of the surprises for the event itself, so please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/3ea5c0d297286064fa4b61f1da0fb8a303d4c08b.png"][/img][/p][p]In the meantime, from [b]Sept 15 to Sept 29[/b], [i]Stario: Haven Tower[/i] will also be featured in the [b]Steam Publisher Sale by XD[/b]. If you haven’t tried our demo yet, this is a great chance to download it and give it a spin before launch: [/p][p] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387080"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Why Early Access?[/b][/h2][p]We know that in recent years, the tag “Early Access” hasn’t always carried the most positive impression. Honestly, we also had doubts at first about whether choosing Early Access might affect how people see our game.[/p][p]But after much discussion, we decided to stick with this path. Not only because we believe the game has room to grow, but also because we want to shape it together with you, our community. With your feedback and support, we hope to refine and expand the tower into something closer to everyone’s ideal vision.[/p][p]That said, “Early Access” doesn’t mean cutting corners. The EA release already includes [b]the full main storyline, three difficulty modes, and dozens of hours of content[/b]. You’ll be able to unlock the complete tech tree and tower progression, and climb all the way to the very top.[/p][p]For us, Early Access represents both our vision and our honesty: [i]Stario: Haven Tower[/i] still has a long way to go before it becomes the “perfect version” we imagine [i](if such a thing even exists for any developer)[/i]. There are still many possibilities waiting ahead—and we’d love to explore them together with you.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Will Demo Saves Carry Over?[/b][/h2][p]Unfortunately, [b][u]save data from the demo will not be compatible with the EA version[/u][/b]. This was a tough call—we really wanted to keep everyone’s progress, but the game has gone through major changes based on both our internal testing and feedback from the community.[/p][p]Sometimes we added new features; other times, we realized that a system simply wasn’t working and had to rebuild it from scratch. Since Next Fest, we’ve also made extensive changes to balance: recipe formulas, resource ratios in each area, buff types and values for different tower sections, and more. As a resource-management and city-building game, these numbers are central to the overall experience. Adjusting them is key to making the game more diverse and giving players more freedom in how they approach the climb.[/p][p]Because of all this, we had to let go of save compatibility—but we hope you’ll find that starting fresh in the EA version makes for an even richer and more rewarding experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/9557d877f3219a245f21bfcdd8e7ef2b9c4c6f70.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2][p]We’ll be sharing more details on what the EA version includes, along with the new features we’ve been working on, in our September 18 update post.[/p][p]If you run into any issues while playing the demo, or if you’d like to chat with other players, feel free to join our [b]official Discord server[/b]: [url="https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7"]https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7[/url][/p][p]We also share dev logs and behind-the-scenes updates on our socials—follow along if you’d like to see more ⬇️⬇️⬇️[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update on Jun 6 & Save Data Notice
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We are rolling out a major update for the demo of our game, STARIO: the Heaven Tower, on [b]June 6[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]In this new version, the lockable tower layers will increase from 8 to [b]12 floors[/b], and we’re introducing a brand-new brace technology - a key tech to strengthen tower stability and expand your structures horizontally, for more creative freedom to build your unique sky-high architecture.[/p][p][/p][p]We've also made improvements to citizen needs, upgraded tower-building animations, and added clearer tutorials—all designed to make your skyword journey more engaging and rewarding![/p][p][/p][p]Try out the demo on Steam! [/p][p]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387080/_Demo/[/p][h2]Save Files Compatibility & Legacy Branch Access[/h2][p]Since the new patch brings significant changes to core gameplay mechanics (we have reworked the whole buff system by the way), please note that[b] the existing save files will not be compatible with the new version.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]As a simulation game that heavily involves resource management, updates to the balancing system—especially the rework of various stats—are a key part of refining the player experience and enhancing the flow of tower construction.[/p][p][/p][p]We [b]strongly recommend starting fresh with the new version[/b] to enjoy all improvements. However, for players who wish to continue their previous save files, we’ll open a temporary legacy branch after the new update. This will allow you to switch back and continue building your tower up to floor 12 in the older version:[/p][list][*][p] Right-click on the game in your Steam library[/p][/*][*][p] Select [i]Properties[/i][/p][/*][*][p] Click the [i]BETAS[/i] tab[/p][/*][*][p] In the list under "Select the beta you would like to opt-in to", select “v0.1.7_legacy”[/p][/*][*][p] Close the properties menu

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/27a01cae6d15c521f7201d49417ff7e55f8e31e6.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that the legacy branch is [b]only available during the demo period[/b]. After Steam Next Fest, we’ll be gathering feedback and continuing to make major adjustments, thus we can’t guarantee demo save files will carry over to the full release. [i]Babel wasn’t built in a day[/i], right?  [/p][p][/p][p]Through early feedback and shared effort with our community, we hope to deconstruct, rebuild, and ultimately deliver a more stable and complete tower-building experience at launch.[/p][p][/p][h2]June 6 Update Log[/h2][h3]Features:[/h3][list][*][p] [b]Tower construction limit raised to 12 layers[/b].[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Housing Upgrade System[/b]: When Spirit conditions are met, Huts can automatically upgrade into Brick Houses, increasing living space and work range.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/e83e7daa01202d2a23a569c06f95681bcf27ae2d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p] [b]Brace Technology unlocked[/b]: Use braces beneath buildings to reinforce them, significantly expanding horizontal construction potential.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/2a4568b488adb0570d187a2ae61769ad3a94dd21.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p] New Structures – Small & Large Frames: Lighter than structural blocks, ideal for horizontal expansion or creative stacking.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Disasters can blow away Towertizens with low Disaster Shelter[/b] (let’s hope they land safely!).[/p][/*][*][p] Rare resources may be brought in by disasters – make good use of them![/p][/*][*][p] Industrial Core and Ecological Garden now support selecting multiple production items for bonus output.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Some buildings now require ongoing item consumption to maintain their bonus effects[/b] (e.g., Greenhouse consumes Water).[/p][/*][*][p] Added tutorial guidance for Build Menu, Demolition Tool, Brace Tool, Housing Upgrade, Stability Mode, and Single-layer Display Mode.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Changes:[/h3][list][*][p] Small Balloon Station can now transport two types of items.[/p][/*][*][p] During disasters, no new Towertizens will arrive, and [b]certain items will be consumed faster[/b].[/p][/*][*][p] Visual effects for Mist disasters have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p] Plantations and Farms now occupy 3 height units.[/p][/*][*][p] Adjusted Towertizen model scale – now about 3 meters tall (down from 5 meters).[/p][/*][*][p] Research speed has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p] Added more animations for Towertizens working in buildings.[/p][/*][*][p] Added several sound effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bugfixes:[/h3][list][*][p] Fixed an issue where new Pipes connected to under-construction ones could become suspended in midair.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where stored resources in the tower body would not display correctly when exceeding 1000 units.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI：[/h3][list][*][p] Added Traditional Chinese localization.[/p][/*][*][p] Save menu now shows save version info and warns of incompatible versions.[/p][/*][*][p] Updated tooltip: replaced "Overhanging Weight" with the clearer term "Stability".[/p][/*][*][p] Selecting a residence now highlights its work range across tower layers.[/p][/*][*][p] Renamed "Shrub Garden" to "Plantation".[/p][/*][*][p] Added a custom program icon for the game.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed several localization errors and text overflow issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you encounter any issues during the demo, or you have any idea that you want to share with us, feel free to click the banner and join our Discord for support and feedback:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/240c45e6709e7fc5195ca878b8ad6b8cfa66defe.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update Log v0.1.7.1716
notes.notes:
Hey Towertizens, Big thanks for all your awesome support and feedback. In this update, we've squashed some bugs and added a few helpful tweaks. Wish you keep enjoying your sky-high tower journey! 
Here is today's full update log:

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced English font to improve legibility at smaller sizes.
[*] Added tutorial hint for planting cactus in Shrub Gardens.
[*] When setting items for storage buildings or balloon stations, only unlocked items will now appear in the list.
[*] Added a warning when constructing Jellyfish Bay: replaced tower layers will lose their bonuses.
[*] Added feedback buttons to the pause menu.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where removing ghosted buildings could cause tower layers to overlap with Jellyfish Bay.
[*] Fixed an issue introduced in v0.1.6.1653 where some buildings could no longer be selected (invalid buildings caused by the update will now be removed).
[*] Fixed a bug where background images in the opening scene were stretched abnormally at certain screen resolutions.
[*] Fixed a bug where Greenhouses and Signposts did not lose durability over time.
[*] Fixed a bug where custom keybindings were not reflected in button prompt text.
[*] Fixed a bug where Towertizens could be left floating after a building was removed.
[*] Fixed an issue where some save file entries did not display proper save details.
[*] Fixed several localization errors and text overflow issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Log v0.1.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It’s been two weeks since the demo of [i]Stario: Haven Tower[/i] went live, and we’ve been incredibly encouraged by all the positive feedback and thoughtful suggestions from players. Thank you so much for your support!


Here’s what’s included in this update:

[h3]Feature:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new "Minimum Number of Porters" setting and related tutorial. No more worrying about accidental shortage of Porters.
[*] Added Volume Control Settings.
[*] Added a new "Clear Items in Pipe" function to resolve blockage issues.
[/list]

[h3]Change:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the explanation for buildings lacking workers: “Too far from Houses” -> “Not enough nearby Towertizens.”
[*] Changed the tutorials.
[*] Increased the number of starting Towertizens.
[*] Slowed down the text speed in the opening animation.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfix:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several localization errors and missing translations.
[/list]

Due to changes in the tutorials, progress of the tutorial will be reset for saves from previous versions. However, this does not affect the continued playability of existing save files.
If you have any thoughts or questions about the current version, feel free to join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3209750/discussions/]community[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7]Discord[/url] to discuss them.
